rationale: The job already caches pnpm dependencies (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is satisfied), has no matrix (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST not applicable), and is not scheduled (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE/P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE not applicable). The supported fit is P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT: bound the job with an explicit timeout derived from representative successful-duration history. The CI history shows five successful runs completing in about 11-14 minutes (max ~14 min), while the job currently allows 40 minutes, leaving wide room for runaway consumption. Reducing the timeout to 20 minutes preserves every build/test step and required check, adds operational headroom over the observed maximum, and is consistent with the measured P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT experiment (elapsed savings ~26.8%) and the pattern's reported runaway-consumption reduction. No permissions, secrets, deployment, or new network access is changed.
